data.name: Nassirah
data.gender_notes: Nassirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root nasara, which means 'to give good news'. This name is given to a girl who is believed to bring happiness and joy to those around her. The name Nassirah carries the meaning “Giver of good news” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nassirah usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Goddess Nassrain, signifying the giver of good news and blessings.
data.etymology: Nassirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of good news.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nassirah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نصيره

in_urdu.name: ناصرہ
in_urdu.meaning: ناصرہ یعنی اللہ کی مدد اور حمایت
in_urdu.long_meaning: ناصرہ نام علم مؤنث ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفعل نصر سے ماخوذ ہے جس کے معنی ہیں مدد کرنا یا حمایت کرنا اس نام کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی مدد اور حمایت ناصرہ نام کی اصطلاحی معنی اس کے عربی جڑ الفعل سے ملتی ہیں جو قرآن کریم میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے جیسے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کا ارشاد ﴿وإن تنصروا اللہ ينصرکم﴾

in_hindi.long_meaning: नासिरा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के क्रियापद नصر से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है मदद करना या समर्थन करना इस नाम का अर्थ है ईश्वर की सहायता और समर्थन इस नाम की व्युत्पत्ति उसके अरबी मूल क्रियापद से होती है जो कुरआन में भी प्रयोग हुआ है जैसे कि अल्लाह का कथन ﴿وَإِنْ تَنْصُرُوا اللَّهَ يَنْصُرْكُمْ﴾
